svg.aria-label: A terminal styled like a coding agent CLI. The command "rithvik --hello" prints RITHVIK in rotating ASCII letters, then a welcome panel for Rithvik Praveen Kumar, Greater Boston, MA, with a turning ASCII ouroboros. About: CS + Math @ Purdue. Builds intelligent software for an intelligent world. Stack: Python, TypeScript, Java, C++, React, AWS. Into: AI systems, applied ML, brain-computer interfaces.
svg.title: Rithvik Praveen Kumar
